requirement_summary: Tier-2 enhanced human review when any listed trigger is present; decision-quality sampling
cost_driver: grants with a Tier-2 trigger (base 9% of grants, EV-E10)
infrastructure_impact: Dossier service with deterministic findings section (CNV-AIO-002); queue and clocks
alternative_approaches: Reuse recipient-level determinations across grants and funds; calibrate trigger specificity per trigger from replay false-positive rates; batch accountable decisions on dossiers; sponsor-specific amount thresholds only where risk-justified
prevention_mechanisms: Pre-validated policy at recommendation (EV-E10 prevention 0.25); affiliation attestation feeding screens; closed charity picker
risk_implications: Removing triggers would expose §4966/§4967 taxable distributions and prohibited benefits
control_objective_preserved: Enhanced human review of genuinely risky grants retained; only false-positive triggers are tuned
validation_method: 90-day time study plus 12-month shadow replay at first sponsor (CNV-ECO-003, CNV-EVB-001); per-trigger false-positive rate

requirement_summary: Reserved (A3+) authority only for sponsor-board-appointed persons; Unbound staff may not hold it; one sponsor per person
cost_driver: roster coverage by role and day for reserved decision classes, independent of volume
expected_frequency: per sponsor: 2-12 appointments/yr; DecisionTeam floor assumed 0.5 FTE per holder (UNB-SMP-ORG-003#Q3, open)
alternative_approaches: Contracted or fractional appointees (permitted by CNV-GOV-004); shared bench of pre-appointed reviewers each appointed by only one sponsor; time share set from measured workload rather than 0.5 FTE default
prevention_mechanisms: Push conforming decisions to board-delegated policy (CNV-GRT-001)
risk_implications: Staffing floor dominates small sponsors' economics; under-coverage risks missed deadlines
control_objective_preserved: Accountable appointed human for reserved decisions preserved
validation_method: Measure reserved-decision minutes per holder in pilot; governance decision on time share (RR-UNB-ECO-003-r1#Q1)

requirement_summary: Deterministic approval only after a board/committee delegation; otherwise every grant is an individual batch decision
expected_frequency: 0 grants/yr at steady state; up to 90k/yr if no delegation (freq_high)
alternative_approaches: Make board delegation an activation gate with packaged resolutions; time-boxed pre-delegation with sampling instead of 100% review where counsel permits (RCD-005 open)
prevention_mechanisms: Packaged resolution and policy pack at onboarding
risk_implications: Without delegation the platform's economics collapse to conventional review volumes
control_objective_preserved: Sponsor exercises legal control via board-adopted policy
validation_method: Track delegation lead time per sponsor; pre-delegation phase time study (CNV-ECO-005)

requirement_summary: SoD: deterministic release counts as releaser only after auditor/board acceptance; until then three distinct persons; reconciliation outside payment chain; enforced leave
cost_driver: daily payment batches per sponsor; reconciliation staffing outside payment chain
expected_frequency: 250 batches/sponsor-yr; 50% assumed still human-released in blended year
infrastructure_impact: Release gate, fencing tokens, ITGC evidence
external_costs: Outsourced reconciler where internal SoD impossible (SPD-ORG-006, UNKNOWN cost)
alternative_approaches: Obtain auditor and board acceptance of deterministic release design at onboarding; outsourced reconciler for small sponsors; exception-only human release for out-of-policy items
prevention_mechanisms: Hold fencing at dispatch; positive pay; destination evidence
risk_implications: Three-person rule creates a minimum headcount per sponsor; SoD failure enables fraud
control_objective_preserved: Independent release and independent reconciliation preserved
validation_method: Auditor walkthrough of release gate; release time log

requirement_summary: Continuous reconciliation; auto-pass with independent attestation sample; provisional calibration with 100% review; monthly controller sign-off
cost_driver: transactions x break rate; monthly attestation; new sources
expected_frequency: break 2% of 12.5 transactions/account-yr; 12 attestations and 12 sign-offs per sponsor-yr; 5 new sources per onboarding
infrastructure_impact: Matching engine; break queues; feed calibration
responsible_organization: administrator (reconciler outside payment chain) and sponsor controller
alternative_approaches: Reuse calibrated mappings across sponsors to shorten provisional calibration; error-bound sample sizing; pooled reconciliation service across sponsors (non-decision work can be pooled)
prevention_mechanisms: Single ledger with continuous reconciliation (EV-E13 prevention 0.5); structured intents
risk_implications: Breaks block statements for affected funds; undetected breaks misstate audited statements
validation_method: Break rate per 1,000 transactions; attestation sample findings

requirement_summary: Periods, soft/hard close, checklists, period locks and certification
alternative_approaches: Continuous close with exception-only certification; shared close workbench across sponsors on one cluster; quarterly hard close with monthly soft close where audit permits
risk_implications: Late or wrong statements; audit findings
control_objective_preserved: Controller certification of period completeness preserved

requirement_summary: Audit schedules, roll-forwards, drill-down, external auditor access and evidence export
external_costs: External audit fee (sponsor, exists regardless; UNKNOWN)
alternative_approaches: Evidence by default; auditor walkthrough to agree reliance on automated controls (EV-E22 held at conventional minutes until then)
control_objective_preserved: Audit trail and auditor access preserved

requirement_summary: NAV publishes by policy under IC delegation; exceptions to human approver; next-day independent sample; annual delegation review
expected_frequency: 250 valuations per sponsor-yr; sample on 50% of days
alternative_approaches: Where values come from the external manager's unit values, sample weekly or on risk triggers rather than daily; IC-approved tolerance bands per asset class
risk_implications: Misstated balances flow into grants and statements
control_objective_preserved: Independent review of published values preserved
validation_method: Exception days and sample findings over 12 months

requirement_summary: Status check at approval and release; 180-day deep review with refresh 30 days before expiry; event invalidation
cost_driver: active recipient charities x 2 renewals/yr; failures
expected_frequency: 27,000 renewals/yr at 13,500 charities; 1% fail to human
alternative_approaches: Change-driven monitoring with evidence expiry instead of fixed interval (CA-180); renewal by deterministic policy with no human sign-off (SPD-GRT-001 open)
prevention_mechanisms: Continuous monitoring; reuse across sponsors of public facts (CNV-GRT-004)
risk_implications: Interim loss of status between reviews
control_objective_preserved: Current status verified at decision and release preserved

requirement_summary: Screen all parties at onboarding, on list delta and before each release; human disposition; OFAC reporting
external_costs: Free OFAC lists; optional vendor lists (UNKNOWN)
alternative_approaches: Tuned token matcher and list hygiene (0.9 vs 10.5 alerts per 1,000 names)
prevention_mechanisms: Pre-screen at onboarding; delta screening rather than full rescreen
control_objective_preserved: Every release screened against current list preserved

requirement_summary: Positive pay; destination evidence before first electronic payment and after changes; independent callback; cooling-off and prior-channel notice
cost_driver: new destinations, bank changes and check issue
expected_frequency: 1,350 new destinations and 675 bank changes/yr at 13,500 charities
external_costs: Owner-match or micro-deposit ~$1.50 per destination (ECO-002); positive pay bank fees (UNKNOWN)
alternative_approaches: Bank-originated account-owner match (option a) to avoid callbacks; reuse networked-rail enrolments (CNV-EXP-002); risk-tiered first-payment caps
prevention_mechanisms: Electronic enrolment; destination reuse across sponsors where lawful
risk_implications: Payment redirection (BEC) is the dominant grant fraud vector
validation_method: Enrolment funnel minutes; fraud attempts caught

requirement_summary: VoidDisposition from statute-derived state unclaimed-property rows; default Hold
alternative_approaches: Shift recipients to electronic rails; outreach automation before ageing tiers
control_objective_preserved: Correct disposition of uncashed grants preserved

requirement_summary: Unknown outcomes need trace before final tier; Unobtainable after 30 days to two independent approvers; no auto-retry
alternative_approaches: Rails with status query by idempotency key (TVR-PAY-002) reduce unknowns
control_objective_preserved: No duplicate payment without independent acceptance preserved

requirement_summary: Sponsor originates; Unbound is TPSP with Nacha risk-based fraud monitoring and audit cooperation
expected_frequency: 12 reviews per sponsor-yr; 1 annual TPSP audit
alternative_approaches: Single platform-level monitoring program covering all sponsors with sponsor-specific overlays

requirement_summary: Common case kernel; business-calendar clocks; assignment modes
expected_frequency: 5,000 human contacts/yr at 10k accounts (0.5 per account)
alternative_approaches: Proactive StatusProjection notices; grounded AI answers; shared service pool across sponsors

requirement_summary: Statements every configured period; complaint clocks
alternative_approaches: Quarterly digest default (already); annual statement where program terms allow
control_objective_preserved: Periodic statement and complaint handling preserved

requirement_summary: Risk-based identity proofing; step-up; AAL3 for privileged roles
alternative_approaches: Reliance on custodian/advisor KYC where recorded

requirement_summary: Verified-channel change notifies prior channel; 72-hour hold on sensitive actions; accessible assurance path
alternative_approaches: Sponsor-configured recommendation threshold so hold does not apply to all non-recurring recommendations
risk_implications: Takeover vs donor friction in December
control_objective_preserved: Takeover protection and equal access preserved

requirement_summary: Death/incapacity: hold, verify, suspend only that person; successor funds with response window and contact attempts
alternative_approaches: Cradle-to-grave case owner; pre-captured designations; AI-prepared evidence summaries (human decides, UNB-ING-DAF-009)
control_objective_preserved: Human decision on succession evidence preserved

requirement_summary: Complex assets via agent model; sponsor donee of record; disclosed reasonable service charges
alternative_approaches: Contracted intermediary that sells on receipt; standard acceptance checklists; refuse UBTI assets (CNV-FIN-010)

requirement_summary: Record Form 8283 Section B signature events and track disposition window
alternative_approaches: Pre-filled forms from intake; e-signature

requirement_summary: Four contribution dates; reversals void acknowledgments; per-donor exposure limits
alternative_approaches: Account validation at mandate; availability holds sized from data
control_objective_preserved: Correct gift dates and reversal handling preserved

requirement_summary: Securities gift intake collects GiftIntent with delivering participant before transfer
alternative_approaches: Per-fund virtual references in DTC memo; advisor-platform API intent
prevention_mechanisms: This requirement is itself the prevention lever

requirement_summary: Handle unidentified deposits, rejected gifts, returned assets and incomplete transfers
alternative_approaches: Notification-first intent with unique fund reference (EV-E04 prevention 0.6); virtual account per fund
control_objective_preserved: No plug postings; every receipt resolved
validation_method: 90-day time study plus 12-month shadow replay at first sponsor (CNV-ECO-003, CNV-EVB-001); suspense ageing

requirement_summary: Schedule D Part I per tax year with typed bridge to audited statements
alternative_approaches: Continuous bridge maintained through the year; shared CPA-approved mapping across sponsors

requirement_summary: Corrections in open period with class; period 13 for audit adjustments; CFO materiality; annual functional expense policy
expected_frequency: 40 corrections and 2 policy approvals per sponsor-yr
alternative_approaches: Upstream prevention of recurring correction classes (REQ-X-042)

requirement_summary: SoD for journal preparation, approval, posting, bank/payee changes, reconciliations, close
alternative_approaches: Expand rule-based posting to shrink manual journals
control_objective_preserved: Second approver on manual journals preserved

requirement_summary: SOC 1 and SOC 2 evidence engineering from inception; auditor planned approach before reliance
external_costs: SOC 1 type 2 and SOC 2 examination fees (UNKNOWN; obtain quotes)
alternative_approaches: Combined SOC 1/SOC 2 examination; scope set by actual reliance (no stand-alone type 1 unless contracted)

requirement_summary: Vendor assurance monitoring; bridge letters; annual review task in release 1
expected_frequency: 15 vendor reviews/yr; 5 sponsor reviews of Unbound
alternative_approaches: Automate gap computation; review only vendors with relevant CUECs

requirement_summary: Versioned policy packs; material changes need affirmative adoption and independent approval; shadow replay
expected_frequency: 6 sponsor changes per sponsor-yr; 4 platform changes/yr
alternative_approaches: Pre-approved parameter ranges inside packs so in-range tuning is not 'material'; platform-wide packs adopted once with objection window (SPD-CFG-001)
control_objective_preserved: Independent approval of material control changes preserved

requirement_summary: Every mandatory human step carries justification, owner, review date and automation alternative; annual review
alternative_approaches: Review only on material change plus sampled annual review

requirement_summary: Quarterly board report on delegated automation with sampled human reviews; renewal refused without acknowledgment
alternative_approaches: Fully generated report with sampled reviews reused from UNB-XIN-CLM-005; board acknowledges rather than re-reviews
control_objective_preserved: Board oversight of delegated automation preserved

requirement_summary: Monthly stratified random sample of closed grant approvals
alternative_approaches: Error-bound sample sizes per stratum; reduce sample as measured error falls
control_objective_preserved: Independent quality check of automated decisions preserved

requirement_summary: Two approvers (neither author) on control-relevant module changes; signed builds; release notices
alternative_approaches: Smaller change sets; tagging precision so only truly control-relevant modules need two approvers

requirement_summary: AI may recommend/prepare only; machine-readable assistance docs; model and prompt change control
alternative_approaches: Shared evaluation sets across sponsors; change freeze around December

requirement_summary: Operator access denied by default; sponsor pre-approves scoped expiring read; per-case write approval
alternative_approaches: Standing scoped read delegations for defined diagnostic classes (CNV-TEN-001 ServiceDelegation)
control_objective_preserved: Sponsor control of operator access preserved

requirement_summary: Quarterly access recertification for privileged and workforce roles
alternative_approaches: JIT privilege reduces standing access to recertify

requirement_summary: Staffing forecasts; December readiness gate with pre-appointed qualified reviewers before 1 December
alternative_approaches: Shared pre-appointed bench (each appointee serves one sponsor) contracted across sponsors; surge triggers from forecast

requirement_summary: Sponsor-scoped versioned answer corpus of approved clauses
alternative_approaches: Shared platform corpus with sponsor overrides only for program terms

requirement_summary: Sponsor migration imports full fund history with reconciliation report
alternative_approaches: Reusable extract mappings per incumbent; migration factory; rehearsal gate

requirement_summary: Onboarding configuration through at most 15-question Outcome Questionnaire and policy packs
alternative_approaches: Closed extension-point catalogue (UNB-ONB-024); no forks
control_objective_preserved: Sponsor adoption of its policies preserved

requirement_summary: Integration certification lifecycle for counterparties
cost_driver: integration upkeep events and file exceptions
alternative_approaches: Reuse mappings across sponsors; prefer direct APIs; certify once per counterparty not per sponsor

requirement_summary: Register as charitable fundraising platform with CA AG and HI AG before activating white-label/embedded features
alternative_approaches: Launch sponsor-direct deployments that may not require registration (interpretation pending)

requirement_summary: Retention classes; 10-year floor for transaction records; legal holds override
external_costs: Object storage (metered; FIE: ~$4,600/yr incl. scanning and AI at 100k funds)
alternative_approaches: Single 10-year floor avoids per-record classification (already adopted)

requirement_summary: Meter cost drivers; non-posting cost attribution reconciled to invoices
alternative_approaches: Quarterly reconciliation with monthly automated residual checks

requirement_summary: Neutral decline catalog; reconsideration decided by independent reviewer
alternative_approaches: Clear policy text; pre-decision explanations reduce requests

requirement_summary: Pledge policy; payee substitution for merger successors; taxable-distribution remediation
alternative_approaches: One charity-succession record drives all affected grants and notices
risk_implications: Grants to wrong entity; excise tax

requirement_summary: No-portal charity experience for grant receipt
alternative_approaches: Rich remittance and public status lookup reduce contacts

requirement_summary: Atomic reservation at approval; sponsor-approved liquidity buffer from stress model
alternative_approaches: Buffer calibrated from 12 months of outflows; waterfall defaults

requirement_summary: Dispute freeze rules; sponsor-initiated bulk transfers fund by fund
alternative_approaches: Exportable logical dataset per partner (UNB-TEN-016) reduces exit effort
control_objective_preserved: Sponsor control of disputed assets preserved

requirement_summary: Affiliation declarations at onboarding and annual attestation
alternative_approaches: Event-driven prefilled confirmation instead of annual attestation (SPD-ENT-004)
